reason: E2 states that Al₂O₃ acts as a diffusion barrier in oxidative environments, but neither E1 nor E2 addresses boride substrates, molten aluminum corrosion, or the formation of protective Al₂O₃ on borides. The key premises about the mechanism in molten Al and the predicted improvement are unsupported by the cited evidence.
premises: Al₂O₃ acts as an effective diffusion barrier against oxidation/corrosion.
A continuous, adherent Al₂O₃ scale can be formed by controlled oxidation.
The pre-formed Al₂O₃ layer will impede molten aluminum attack on the boride substrate.
The treatment will yield a >20% improvement in service lifetime.
